learning_objectives.en: Understand should, have to and must in university contexts.

passages.title: R-B
passages.text: University life is different from school life. Students may have only a few lectures each week but they are expected to study independently for many more hours. Tutorials and seminars help students discuss ideas in small groups. A balanced university life also includes clubs, sports and social activities.
